description: This file defines the implementation of the Eos class, which manages the end-of-stream signaling for a WebAudio player context within a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods, and interacts with external GStreamer wrapper and logging components.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Class responsible for signaling end-of-stream in a WebAudio player context using GStreamer.

methods.name: Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos object with a WebAudioPlayerContext and a GStreamer wrapper.

methods.name: ~Eos
methods.description: Destructor that handles cleanup and logs the end of Eos processing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Method that performs the end-of-stream signaling by calling gstAppSrcEndOfStream on the GStreamer source.
